tokens.DOTA_Tooltip_ability_razor_plasma_field_: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. The Lightning Revenant rules the Underscape with plasmatic power.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_razor_bio: Among the emblematic powers that populate the Underscape, Razor the Lightning Revenant is one of the most feared. With his whip of lightning, he patrols the Narrow Maze, that treacherous webwork of passages by which the souls of the dead are sorted according to their own innate intelligence, cunning and persistence. Drifting above the Maze, Razor looks down on the baffled souls below, and delivers jolts of scalding electricity that both punish and quicken the souls as they decide their own fates, hurrying on toward luminous exits or endlessly dark pits. Razor is the eternal embodiment of a dominating power, abstract and almost clinical in his application of power. Yet he has a lordly air that suggests he takes a sardonic satisfaction in his work.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_razor_hype: With a deadly lightning storm at his command, Razor charges into battle. Deploying a sweeping ring of electrified plasma to fry his enemies, he links with foes to drain them of their power and use it against them.

qualifications.raw:
* The {{Symbol|Forked Lightning}} Forked Lightning ability effects are applied as follows:
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
**# Applies its {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} instance before the enemy's ability cast on Razor.
**#* Deals spell damage before the ability is cast, if the enemy unit {{M|dies}} to the damage instance, the ability is unused.
**#* Certain sources that usually prevents damage do not save the enemy caster if the damage instance is lethal. This includes the following sources:
**#** {{M|Damage negation}} sources.
**#** {{M|Spell immunity}} sources.
**# The original ability cast.

* The proc chance uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}}, and has two proc conditions:
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-1.png|21px|1]]
*** For successful attacks on Razor: {{Proc|{{#var:Storm Surge value1}}}}
**** Does not proc from the following attack sources:
***** {{M|Buildings}}
*** {{cf|shdnotes}}
**** For successful attacks on Razor while {{A|Razor|Eye of the Storm}} is active: {{Procshd|{{#var:Storm Surge type3 value2 shd}}}}
*** The {{Symbol|Forked Lightning}} Forked Lightning ability effects applied as follows upon proc:
***# Applies the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} to the attack source, this component only affects enemy units.
***# Applies the {{M|debuff}} to the attack source.
***# Search for valid enemy units for the Forked Lightning component.
** [[File:Dota2 Condition-2.png|21px|2]]
*** {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} 
**** Has a {{M|Global}} proc radius and an ensure proc chance on every offensive unit-targeted ability cast on Razor, including certain {{Symbol|Target|Unit}} {{Symbol|Target|Ground}} unit and ground-targeted abilities.
**** {{Symbol|Projectile|Base}}
***** Procs the {{Symbol|Forked Lightning}} Forked Lightning component upon the offensive [[projectile]] launch.
***** The offensive ability cast still takes effect even if the ability source {{M|dies}} to the {{M|spell damage|x}} applied.
**** Affects the following units:
***** {{M|Fogged units}}.
***** {{M|Invisible}} units.

* {{Symbol|Forked Lightning}}
** Does not apply to, and considers the primary target not a valid enemy unit when affected by the following sources:
*** {{M|Debuff immune}} sources.
*** {{M|Hidden}} sources.
*** {{M|Invulnerable}} sources.
** On secondary targets:
*** The search radius is centered around the primary enemy unit that procs the Forked Lightning component.

fields.name: desc0
fields.value:
Releases a plasma wave that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path.

Each enemy unit can be hit twice, once each upon expanding and contracting. The further the distance, the stronger the effect.

fields.name: desc1

fields.name: debuff1text

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The ability has the following properties:
** Has a total {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Plasma Field value1}}/{{#var:Plasma Field basic1}}*2 round2}}-second expand and contract time.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Interrupts Razor's {{M|channeling}} abilities upon cast.
*** Centered on Razor upon cast for the entire duration.
*** {{Symbol|Vision|Flying}}
**** Grants a {{#expr:{{#var:Plasma Field value1}}/{{#var:Plasma Field basic1}}*2 round2}}-second {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#var:Plasma Field value1}}-radius [[flying vision]] following Razor upon cast.
**** The vision component neither expands nor contracts, and has a 2-second trail linger duration.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Ripple}}
*** Both the {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}} and {{M|movement speed}} slow component can affect the same enemy units twice, once per expanding, once per contracting.
**** The total expanding and contracting area-of-effect, ring [[File:Dota2 Letter-b.png|21px|B]] is a {{#var:Plasma Field value2}}-distance wide [[wikipedia:Annulus (mathematics)|annulus]].
**** [[File:Dota2 Razor Plasma Field Radius icon.png|84px|Plasma Field Visualized]]
***** The ring starts {{#var:Plasma Field basic2}}-distance away from Razor ({{Code|OB}}), expands up to the max radius [[File:Dota2 Letter-f.png|21px|F]] , covering a total {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Plasma Field value1}}+{{#var:Plasma Field basic2}}}}-distance.
**** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
***** The ability's visual effects start at Razor's location, centerpoint [[File:Dota2 Letter-o.png|21px|O]] and expands correspondingly.
***** Hence, the ability effects are {{#var:Plasma Field basic2}}-distance behind the damaging ring, and not centered on it.
*** {{Symbol|a|up}}
**** Both ability components' value corresponds to the ring travel distance, reaching max values at {{Symbol|bonus aoe}} {{#expr:{{#var:Plasma Field value1}}+{{#var:Plasma Field basic2}}}} radius, and is defined as:
***** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Values(MAX - MIN) / ({{#expr:({{#var:Plasma Field value1}}+{{#var:Plasma Field value2}})}} + {{#var:Plasma Field basic2}})}}
***** The ability values changes per 100-expanded or contracted distance as follows:
****** {{calc|(v2-v1)/trunc(({{#var:Plasma Field value1}}+{{#var:Plasma Field value2}}+{{#var:Plasma Field basic2}})/100) round2|v1={{#var:Plasma Field value3}}|v2={{#var:Plasma Field value4}}}} {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
****** {{calc|(v2-v1)/trunc(({{#var:Plasma Field value1}}+{{#var:Plasma Field value2}}+{{#var:Plasma Field basic2}})/100) round2|v1={{#var:Plasma Field value5}}|v2={{#var:Plasma Field value6}}|%}} {{M|movement speed}} slow.
*** {{Symbol|Teleport}} {{Symbol|Facing Angle|r}} {{to}} {{hi|Razor}}
**** [[Teleport]] sources heading toward Razor may avoid the Plasma Field ring.
**** Plasma Field applies its ability effects with a {{#var:Plasma Field value2}}-wide ring, which expands and centers around Razor's cast location with {{#var:Plasma Field basic1}}-speed toward the max effect radius.
*** Affect the following units:
**** {{M|Invisible}} units.

* The ability effects are applied as follows per ring:
*# The {{M|magical}} {{M|spell damage}}.
*# {{Symbol|Modifier|Debuff}} {{Code|razor_plasma_field_slow}}
*#* The movement speed slow debuffs of expanding and contracting stack, with their duration independent of each other.
*# {{cf|talnotes}} {{Symbol|bonus t4r}} {{ValueColor||{{#var:Plasma Field type1 value1}}|25tal}} seconds after cast, Plasma Field releases a secondary instance with the following properties:
*#* Works independently upon Razor's {{M|death}}, of Plasma Field's {{M|cooldown}}, and does not cost {{M|mana}}.
*#* Does not proc {{M|on-cast effects}}.
